evals.expected_output: Reads automation-test-plan.md; every AUTO-TASK-xxx becomes an executable dev task with target repo, TC dependency, automation layer, test data/fixture/mock, local+CI commands, report evidence; not 'deferred'
assertions: Output reads automation-test-plan.md and incorporates every AUTO-TASK-xxx into the implementation sequence.
Each AUTO-TASK converted task includes target repo/package, dependent TC-xxx, automation layer, local + CI verification commands, and report evidence.

assertions: 读取技术方案里的单测基建现状。
若有缺口，建议写入 product-unit-test-init 任务和用户可跑的脚本。

evals.prompt: 请写开发计划。技术方案里提到需要配 Git Hook。

assertions: 读取技术方案里的 Git Hook 现状。
若提到 hook，建议写入 product-git-hook-init。
不写「hook 未完成不得进入功能实现」。

evals.expected_output: Each ordered task has file scope, TDD checkpoint (failing test -> expected failure -> implementation -> passing test), verification commands, expected evidence, dependencies, ownership boundaries, and no-parallel implementation rules

Every task has a TDD checkpoint mapped to TC-xxx (failing test first, then implementation).

Each verification command is adjacent to its corresponding task or TC ID.
